item.title: Camera Geometry Playground: Explore Intrinsics, Pose and Lens Distortion
item.description: Move 13 sliders to see how intrinsics, pose and radial distortion change an image. This interactive OpenCV playground helps explain camera geometry; it does not estimate calibration parameters from a real camera.
